text: I'm so sorry to bother you at this hour, I'm looking after my grandson tonight while his mum and dad are away and I've got myself in a real state. He's 4. He had a bit of a cough at teatime, just a little one, nothing much, but when I put him to bed he felt warm so I dug out the thermometer and it says 37.6. I don't know if that's high or not for a little one, I can never remember. I keep thinking about all the things you read about. I did check his neck because I remembered something about that, and he can look right down at his tummy and his toes no bother, he even laughed at me for asking. And he's wide awake, chattering away to me about his dinosaurs and watching his programme, and when he dozed off on the settee earlier he woke up straight away when I said his name. So he seems himself really, it's just me panicking I suppose. His mum would know what to do and I don't want to ring her and worry her when she's so far away. Is there anything I should be doing for him or watching out for through the night? I just want to do the right thing by him.
